title: Issue lifecycle reconciliation and recovery archive
objective: Reconcile Parent/child lifecycle and task readiness from fresh GitHub state, create approved follow-up tasks, and archive completed run state safely.
acceptance_criteria: Parent closes only when all children close and reopens when a new child is added.
Code-dependent tasks wait for upstream PR merge and linked Issue closure; stable documented contracts may support parallel work.
Follow-up Issue links to original and is created only after user approval with impact-based priority.
Completed runs archive with default 30-day retention; active or pending-draft state is not deleted.
undo_classification: Archive before cleanup; never remove active or unowned state.
approval_requirements: Explicit approval before creating follow-up Issues.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; repeated identical remote mismatch escalates.
